summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) auto-runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts and chmods it (mode 493 / 0755), and invokes the downloaded binary to execute a sibling 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file, `math_init.js`. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js use obfuscator.io-style transforms: `_0xNNNN` identifier names, per-function string-constant proxy objects, and a rotating string/number array with a shift routine (`WV8StW`). The package presents itself as `@ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-nestjs` with description "eslint typescript nestjs config files", but ships no eslint configuration content consistent with that purpose; an eslint config has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime and hand it an opaque bundled payload at install time. The `math_init.js` filename is a cover label for the executed payload. The scope/name mirrors the legitimate @ornikar eslint config ecosystem, increasing the chance developers install it believing it is a rules package while the preinstall dropper executes on their machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
